map.输入：智齿牙冠完全位于升支前缘前方（I 类），咬合平面以上（A 位），近中倾斜:
Input: wisdom-tooth crown entirely in front of the anterior ramus border (Class I), above occlusal plane (Class A), mesial tilt 45 deg
Determination: I-A class, relatively adequate space, lower difficulty; if Class II/III or B/C position, difficulty rises.
map.Pell-Gregory 分几类？: How many Pell-Gregory classes are there?
map.按智齿与升支前缘关系分 I/II/III 类（空间递减），按与咬合平面关系分 A: By relation to ramus border: Class I/II/III (decreasing space); by relation to occlusal plane: Class A/B/C (descending position); combined to assess difficulty.
map.按阻生方向分垂直、近中、远中、水平、颊舌向等；水平/近中阻生常难度更高，需结合影: By impaction direction: vertical, mesial, distal, horizontal, buccolingual, etc.; horizontal/mesial impaction is often harder, needs imaging.
map.什么情况要拔智齿？: When should wisdom teeth be extracted?
map.反复冠周炎、龋坏、邻牙压迫吸收、囊肿或正畸需要；下颌神经管邻近者需 CBCT，由: Recurrent pericoronitis, caries, proximal pressure resorption, cyst or orthodontic need; those near the inferior alveolar nerve need CBCT, assessed by oral-maxillofacial surgery.
